system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 2

Beginning at 1st level, you gain a number of White Chakra equal to your level, up to a maximum of 5. If you have less than 5 White Chakra total, each time you gain a level you gain +1 White Chakra, until you reach a maximum of 5. You can spend white chakra in place of normal chakra to cast jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword. You regain spent white chakra when you complete a long rest.
